cause: Notebook genesis materialization omitted panel entity and time dimensions, preventing a declared panel model from reaching its registered runtime.

evidence.ref: focused backend regression: test_workflow_runtime panel/dummy oracle plus test_notebook_routes panel materialization; in-app browser run 94471f01

impact: A typed panel option now validates entity/time dimensions, materializes them, and preserves its panel family rather than silently becoming OLS.
lesson: A model family is available to Notebook only when its typed option, materializer, runtime, admission and result evidence share the same declared semantics.

cause: A receipt-to-branch evidence path was not sufficiently direct when a project exposed more than four candidate runs.
impact: A committed workflow receipt can be read through one bounded lookup across eight candidate runs without exposing raw rows.
lesson: Project-level answering needs one explicit bounded path from visible run candidates to committed receipt and branch artifacts.

cause: The planner and evidence adapter did not publish the already-persisted predictor-residual diagnostic as one public, bounded capability.
impact: Agent context can cite a predictor-residual artifact through aggregate bins while row-level inputs remain absent.
lesson: Planner-visible diagnostics and Agent-readable diagnostics must be published together, with aggregation as the data boundary.

cause: Model figure evidence was node-scoped but not admitted through the Global Agent project-scoped reader.
impact: Global answers can reference persisted model figures with binned numeric evidence and an artifact id, without making node context implicitly global.
lesson: Node-scoped evidence never becomes project-scoped implicitly; a bounded reader is an explicit admission point.

cause: A durable confirmation-gated proposal forced an unnecessary provider turn and could exhaust the step budget.
impact: A durable proposal becomes the successful user-review boundary without an extra provider round trip or false max-steps failure.
lesson: A user-confirmation proposal is a terminal product outcome even when the Agent core remains idle awaiting the user action.

cause: The read-only protocol permitted descriptive covariance comparisons without an explicit restriction against causal attribution from changed significance labels.
impact: The Agent can report changed standard errors, intervals and labels but is forbidden to claim a false result or identify heteroskedasticity from that comparison alone.
lesson: Inference comparison must distinguish observable label changes from unsupported causal or diagnostic mechanisms.

cause: The planning contract left the depends_on JSON shape underspecified, so malformed strings were correctly rejected but not mechanically recoverable.
impact: The contract now distinguishes omission, empty array and malformed string while keeping malformed dependency declarations fail-closed.
lesson: A typed optional field needs both an exact wire shape and a distinct recovery message for each structurally different user-visible state.

cause: The UI reconstructed child session navigation from scope only, so moving to a workflow output could lose the durable transcript binding.

evidence.ref: in-app browser run 94471f01: Graph to Table navigation retained transcript; agentNavigation backend/frontend regressions

impact: A workflow-produced run uses the server-recorded child session binding, so selected result navigation preserves the relevant Agent transcript.
lesson: Navigation must preserve a durable server-recorded session identity instead of inferring transcript scope from the currently focused node.

cause: The earlier persisted legacy Notebook Not Found report could not be deterministically reproduced from an old-shape fixture.
impact: Legacy persisted Notebook loading and compilation are covered, but there is no established cause to safely change production code.
lesson: When a persisted-state failure does not reproduce through its historical shape, retain the incident and record the exact attempted path instead of inventing a repair.

cause: A current run stopped by a generic input guardrail was presented as an opaque legacy lineage record.

evidence.ref: WorkbenchRouteContainer guardrail-blocked run regression plus in-app browser supported-fixture acceptance

impact: Current blocked runs show an explicit blocked state and explanation, while supported fixtures continue to complete normal selected-node acceptance.
lesson: A current blocked operation and a historical opaque lineage record have different semantics and must never share a user-facing state.

cause: The in-app browser controller rejects refreshing a stale local tab after a service restart under its own URL policy.

evidence.ref: in-app browser fresh-tab procedure: create a new acceptance tab after restart; no HTTP or external-browser bypass

impact: Browser acceptance can restart from a clean in-app tab without misclassifying the controller policy as a Workbench product defect.
lesson: After a local service restart, rebuild a clean in-app-browser acceptance tab rather than forcing stale-tab navigation or substituting HTTP evidence.

cause: The original DeepSeek V4 Pro failure occurred before any tool call, but this remediation session did not obtain a new provider-side reproduction that can establish a root cause.

evidence.ref: AgentPanel terminal tool failure versus LLMUpstreamError regression; real Flash browser acceptance

impact: Workbench visibly distinguishes upstream provider failure from tool-protocol failure and remains fail-closed, but the original provider incident remains unverified.
lesson: Do not turn a provider outage into a product fix by prompt retries; test failure classification locally and retain the incident until a provider reproduction is attributable.

cause: The declared remediation objective is complete: all twelve original incident IDs have a closing review or gate event, with two honestly retained as open.
impact: The remediation line is closed at its verified scope; legacy Notebook reproduction, provider attribution, host-native containment and release promotion retain their explicit boundaries.
lesson: A remediation line can close with unresolved external or unreproduced incidents only when each is explicitly preserved with its evidence and next boundary.
